reviews.text: My dog loves it here, doesnt even look back when going in and always comes home shattered and happy 🤣🤣 …
Our dog has been a 4 day a week regular for 7 years. Excellent care and facility for dog of all breeds. Much appreciated.

I cant sing the praises of Going Mutts enough. My cocker Spaniel Travis has been going here for a year now and he absolutely loves it. I cant even say the word daycare or he goes nuts and wants to get in the car! From a social aspect this place has also been great for teaching him doggy social etiquette from a young age and I think its definitely help shape him into the lovely young adult dog he is now. Pic of a tired puppy after daycare included!
Amazing doggy day care! My Labrador and Husky love it. Would highly recommend

Can't fault this place. My furbaby loves going here twice a week.
She gets excited when we drive up and runs straight in.
The family who run Going Mutts are a great bunch. Caring with a side of humour. Thanks again.

Been a regular here for a good while now, labrador and husky, they always have a good time. My wife changed workplace so this is now out of my way but I still take them 😉

Many years later still the best

And again no it's still the best, staff are super helpful, and every accommodating 😊

Just had an induction for my miniature dachshund to join the day care. It could not of went any better, they were very informative and were very keen to answer any questions I had. I got to see Gary on the CCTV playing with the other dogs and everything looked amazing!! Can’t wait to get started.
Enquired as a new customer but due to poor customer service and making assumptions I would go elsewhere.
